questions.question: What is skin effect? How does it affect transformer losses?
questions.solution_html:
• Skin effect is the tendency of ac to flow mainly near the surface of a conductor rather
  • than uniformly through its cross section. As a result current density is higher near the
  • surface and lower at the center. Effective resistance of the conductor increases. Power
  • loss increases at high frequencies, etc ((3 marks))
  • Skin effect mainly increases copper losses and heating in transformer windings
  • especially at high frequencies. Also it increases eddy current loss. ((2 marks))
questions.final_answer: especially at high frequencies. Also it increases eddy current loss. ()
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
